Today, the promises of transhumanism and posthumanism are multiplying. These are ideological currents according to which, sooner or later, technology will eliminate all disease and pain, as well as aging and even death itself.
Precisely because scientific progress is a supreme achievement of human intelligence, it must not be confused with a privilege reserved for millionaires seeking immortality, while entire peoples suffer from poverty and oppression. In the face of this mirage, which promotes the illusion of human beings perfected by cybernetics and biotechnology, Christian anthropology reminds us that a limitation is not a manufacturing defect, but rather the very condition of human grandeur. #ApostolicJourney #Peru #MagnificaHumanitas vatican.va/

Guanya Shi, an assistant professor at Carnegie Mellon University's Robotics Institute who had previously heard about OpenAl's reorganization, told Fortune that he would interpret the move as a signal that OpenAl sees robotics as "no longer a special problem." Instead, he said, they likely see robotics as a challenge that can be addressed as a downstream application of general intelligence-similar to the way the same underlying frontier Al models now power specialized coding tools, or tools for legal or financial work.
OpenAl seemed to confirm this view in its response to Fortune. It said that at the start of the year, the company's researchers assumed the best way to make progress on robotics was to build on its work on Al models such as Sora, a video generation model that, in order to create realistic videos, had to have some implicit understanding of how the physical world works.
But since then, the company spokesperson said, the company's general-purpose frontier models, including GPT-6 Astra, have shown that can be directly applied to robotics. This discovery is what motivated OpenAl to disband the stand alone robotics team and move the affiliated researchers onto teams working on more general Al models.

Center foreground: a raised plateau packed with a dense grid of roughly forty pale wooden windmills, linked by power lines on tall poles that run across the map. Upper left: a huge rectangular basin dug into the terrain, with stepped inner walls, a shallow pool, and a grid of walkways crossing its floor. Beside it is a second, sparser array of windmills.

Upper right: the main settlement. It has clusters of round-roofed wooden houses, white multistory buildings, a tall white domed tower, and a stacked multi-tier platform crowded with more windmills. Around it are golden and green crop fields, a dark green tree plantation, rows of crops on reddish soil, and water channels winding between terraces.

The pods hold 6 charges of daylight and regain all of them when returned to their small white reliquary. If separated from the wearer, one pod will invariably roll beneath the nearest couch.
